{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Hall''' was located in the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] in [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. Essentially a large corridor that connected the [[Bakuran Senate Chamber]] to the building's tram station, it was a traditional gathering place for politicians, businessmen and civic leaders.

The floor was a thick, black carpet with a row of columns made from expensive [[Marble/Legends|marble]] with gold tracing. One wall of the Great Hall had a bank of storage lockers for each [[Senator/Legends|senator]], with hand print locks for security purposes. Entrances to the tram station and Senate Chamber were guarded by members of the [[Bakuran Honor Guard]].
